description: Export from the active schematic to a file and return its path: pdf (look at the real drawing; open the path with the Read tool), png, svg, netlist (PADS text), bom (csv), view (image of what the canvas currently shows; may be stale).

options.description: Passed to h.exportFile: {name?, params?, resolution?, type?, tabId?, object?, objectParams?}. pdf exports the current page by default; object: 'Current Schematic' or 'All Schematic' for more.

path.description: Absolute file path or directory. Default: ~/.easyeda-mcp/out/

name: sch_export
